name: DS Cluster S25: Rollover Method Comparison
description: Tests: futures_continuation with LiquidityBased, FirstOfMonth, LastTradingDay rollover methods. Verifies roll event distribution differs by method.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S25: Rollover Method Comparison
# =============================================================================
# S25 rules:
#   LiquidityBased — rolls when back-month volume > front. SAFE DEFAULT.
#   FirstOfMonth — rolls on 1st. OI drops to zero → sawtooth Z-scores.
#   LastTradingDay — rolls on last day of contract.
# If study uses open_interest → MANDATE LiquidityBased.

src = market_data_source()()

# === LiquidityBased (default, safe) ===
cont_liq = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === FirstOfMonth (problematic for OI-based analysis) ===
cont_fom = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === LastTradingDay (simple, predictable) ===
cont_ltd = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LastTradingDay,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === OI comparison — FirstOfMonth should show sawtooth ===
oi_liq = cont_liq.oi
oi_fom = cont_fom.oi
oi_ltd = cont_ltd.oi

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Adjusted Close by Rollover Method',
    category='Rollover',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='LiquidityBased', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='FirstOfMonth', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='LastTradingDay', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cont_liq.c, cont_fom.c, cont_ltd.c))

xy_lines(
    title='Open Interest by Rollover Method',
    category='Rollover',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='OI Liquidity', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='OI FirstOfMonth', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='OI LastTrading', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(oi_liq, oi_fom, oi_ltd))

xy_lines(
    title='Days to Expiry — LiquidityBased vs LastTradingDay',
    category='Rollover',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DTE Liquidity', color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DTE LastTrading', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cont_liq.dte, cont_ltd.dte))
